fact: UNESCO's country profile from the Readiness Assessment Methodology states São Tomé and Príncipe has no national AI strategy and no AI-specific laws or regulations governing the development, use or deployment of AI, and no National AI Ethics Commission or dedicated AI governance structure.

The UNESCO readiness report quotes the Minister of Education as saying no specific laws or regulations exist on the development, use and deployment of AI and no national AI ethics commission or other specific structure exists.
